create_puppet_act_component: create a PuppetActComponent with a language model and fixed response mappings for agent actions
get_action_attempt: get an action response by checking fixed responses first then falling back to the LLM
context_for_action: build a combined context string from component context mappings for agent action prompts
get_state_puppet_act: get the current state including fixed responses from a PuppetActComponent instance
set_state_puppet_act: set the fixed responses state of a PuppetActComponent from a state dictionary
